realWorldSecret.cn: 土豆适合放在阴凉、干燥、避光的地方。太潮或见光太久，都更容易发芽或变坏。
realWorldSecret.en: Potatoes keep best in a cool, dark, and dry place. Too much light or moisture can make them sprout or spoil faster.

realWorldSecret.cn: 整颗洋葱喜欢干燥又通风的环境。别和土豆挨太近，不然两边都可能坏得更快。
realWorldSecret.en: Whole onions prefer a dry and well-ventilated spot. Try not to store them too close to potatoes, as both may spoil faster together.

realWorldSecret.cn: 大蒜适合放在阴凉、干燥、通风处。太潮湿时，它更容易发芽或发霉。
realWorldSecret.en: Garlic keeps best in a cool, dry place with good airflow. Too much moisture can make it sprout or grow mold.

realWorldSecret.cn: 红薯喜欢阴凉干燥的环境，不适合太冷的地方。低温可能会影响它的口感和甜味。
realWorldSecret.en: Sweet potatoes prefer a cool and dry place, not somewhere too cold. Low temperatures can affect both their texture and sweetness.

realWorldSecret.cn: 菠菜最好放在冰箱里，并尽量保持干燥。叶子如果一直潮湿，很快会变软、发黏或腐坏。
realWorldSecret.en: Spinach keeps best in the fridge and should stay as dry as possible. If the leaves stay wet, they can quickly become limp, slimy, or spoiled.

realWorldSecret.cn: 香蕉在室温下更容易自然成熟。放进冰箱后，外皮会很快变黑。
realWorldSecret.en: Bananas ripen naturally at room temperature. In the fridge, the peel can turn dark very quickly.

realWorldSecret.cn: 橙子放常温适合短时间食用。放在阴凉处会比晒到太阳更耐放。
realWorldSecret.en: Oranges can stay at room temperature for short-term use. A cool spot is better than direct sunlight.

realWorldSecret.cn: 整颗柠檬短时间可以放常温。避开高温和阳光，会更不容易失水。
realWorldSecret.en: Whole lemons can stay at room temperature for a short time. Keep them away from heat and direct sunlight so they do not dry out too fast.

realWorldSecret.cn: 苹果放常温适合短期吃完。它会释放乙烯，可能让附近水果熟得更快。
realWorldSecret.en: Apples can stay on the counter if you plan to eat them soon. They release ethylene, which may speed up ripening in nearby fruit.

realWorldSecret.cn: 整颗西瓜放常温没有问题。切开以后就要尽快冷藏，并把切面包好。
realWorldSecret.en: A whole watermelon can stay at room temperature just fine. Once cut, it should be chilled quickly and covered well.

realWorldSecret.cn: 番茄在室温下成熟时风味最好。太早冷藏会让它的香气和口感都变淡。
realWorldSecret.en: Tomatoes taste best while ripening at room temperature. Chilling them too early can dull both flavor and texture.

realWorldSecret.cn: 整颗菠萝可以先放在常温。它采摘后不会继续明显变甜，所以放更久也不会更好吃。
realWorldSecret.en: A whole pineapple can stay at room temperature before cutting. It will not become much sweeter after harvest, so waiting longer will not improve the taste.

realWorldSecret.cn: 黑麦面包密封后放常温就可以。放进冰箱反而更容易变干。
realWorldSecret.en: Rye bread keeps well at room temperature when sealed properly. The fridge often dries bread out faster instead of helping it last.

realWorldSecret.cn: 胡萝卜冷藏会更脆更耐放。带叶的话，最好先把叶子去掉，避免继续失水。
realWorldSecret.en: Carrots stay crisp longer in the fridge. If they still have leafy tops, remove them first so they do not pull out extra moisture.

realWorldSecret.cn: 生姜冷藏能放更久，尤其是切开之后。记得包好，不然很容易变干。
realWorldSecret.en: Fresh ginger keeps longer in the fridge, especially once cut. Wrap it well so it does not dry out too quickly.

realWorldSecret.cn: 茄子放冷藏可以稍微延长保存时间。别放太久，不然容易发软或变色。
realWorldSecret.en: Eggplant can be chilled to help it last a bit longer. Do not keep it too long, or it may soften or discolor.

realWorldSecret.cn: 彩椒冷藏后更容易保持爽脆。梗部通常会最先变软，可以先从那里判断新鲜度。
realWorldSecret.en: Bell peppers stay crisp longer in the fridge. The stem side usually softens first, so check there when deciding if it is still fresh.

realWorldSecret.cn: 西葫芦适合短时间冷藏。开始发软或摸起来有点水水的，就已经不在最佳状态了。
realWorldSecret.en: Zucchini holds up well in the fridge for a short time. If it starts to feel limp or watery, it is already past its best.

realWorldSecret.cn: 葡萄冷藏保存会更稳，保持干燥很重要。最好吃之前再洗。
realWorldSecret.en: Grapes keep better when chilled and kept dry. Wash them right before eating, not before storing.

realWorldSecret.cn: 鸡蛋放冷藏最安心，最好留在原盒里。这样也能减少吸收别的味道。
realWorldSecret.en: Eggs are happiest in the fridge, ideally in their carton. The carton also helps protect them from odors.

realWorldSecret.cn: 甜菜根冷藏后会更耐放。带叶的话最好先分开，因为叶子会继续带走水分。
realWorldSecret.en: Beetroot stores well in the fridge and lasts longer without its leafy tops. The leaves pull moisture away from the root.

realWorldSecret.cn: 牛油果熟了之后再冷藏，能慢一点变过熟。还硬的时候，先放常温会更合适。
realWorldSecret.en: Refrigerate avocados once they are ripe to slow them down. If they are still hard, let them ripen first before chilling.

realWorldSecret.cn: 熟了的猕猴桃放冷藏会更耐放。还偏硬的话，先在室温下放软一点。
realWorldSecret.en: Ripe kiwis last longer in the fridge. If they are still firm, leave them out first and chill them after they soften.

realWorldSecret.cn: 梨熟了以后更适合冷藏。它常常会突然变软，所以记得多看一眼。
realWorldSecret.en: Pears should go into the fridge once ripe. They can turn from perfect to too soft surprisingly fast, so check them often.

realWorldSecret.cn: 熟了的芒果可以冷藏，帮助它多保持一会儿。还硬的时候，先放常温成熟更好。
realWorldSecret.en: A ripe mango can be chilled to help it last a bit longer. If it is still hard, let it ripen on the counter first.

realWorldSecret.cn: 桃子很娇嫩，熟了以后放冷藏更稳。拿取时轻一点，压伤后会坏得特别快。
realWorldSecret.en: Peaches are delicate and bruise easily, so handle them gently in the fridge. Chill them only after they have ripened.

realWorldSecret.cn: 李子熟了以后放冷藏会更耐放。它变软的速度很快，冷藏能帮你多争取一点时间。
realWorldSecret.en: Plums keep well in the fridge once ripe. They soften quickly, so cold storage helps buy you a little extra time.

realWorldSecret.cn: 卷心菜很适合冷藏，整颗通常比切开的更耐放。切开后记得把切面包好。
realWorldSecret.en: White cabbage lasts well in the fridge, especially when kept whole. Once cut, wrap the exposed side to keep it from drying out.

realWorldSecret.cn: 紫甘蓝本身比较耐放，也很适合冷藏。切开后只要把切面盖好，通常还能再放一阵子。
realWorldSecret.en: Red cabbage is sturdy and fridge-friendly. A cut half can still last well if the open side is covered properly.

realWorldSecret.cn: 西兰花冷藏时需要一点点透气。太潮或太闷，都可能让它更快发黄。
realWorldSecret.en: Broccoli keeps best in the fridge with a little airflow. Too much trapped moisture can make it yellow or spoil faster.

realWorldSecret.cn: 羽衣甘蓝适合冷藏，也要尽量保持干爽。叶子一直湿着，会更容易蔫掉。
realWorldSecret.en: Kale likes a cool fridge and a dry bag. If the leaves stay too wet, they wilt and spoil much faster.

realWorldSecret.cn: 生菜冷藏时最怕多余水分。太湿会让叶子很快发软、发黏。
realWorldSecret.en: Lettuce stays freshest when chilled and kept dry. Extra water makes the leaves limp and slimy very quickly.

realWorldSecret.cn: 黄瓜可以放冷藏几天。放太久的话，容易慢慢变软又出水。
realWorldSecret.en: Cucumbers can be stored in the fridge for a few days. If they stay there too long, they may turn soft and watery.

realWorldSecret.cn: 蘑菇冷藏时需要一点透气空间。太闷的话，表面很容易变黏。
realWorldSecret.en: Mushrooms do best in the fridge with a little breathing room. A paper bag is often better than plastic, which can make them slimy.

realWorldSecret.cn: 草莓很怕潮，冷藏时尽量保持干燥。最好吃之前再洗，这样更不容易发霉。
realWorldSecret.en: Strawberries spoil quickly when they stay damp. Keep them chilled and wash them only right before eating.

realWorldSecret.cn: 蓝莓冷藏会更耐放，重点也是别太早洗。多余水分会让它更容易发霉。
realWorldSecret.en: Blueberries keep longer in the fridge, especially when kept dry. Wash them only before eating to avoid extra moisture.

realWorldSecret.cn: 牛奶要稳定冷藏，尽量放在冰箱里面，不要总放门边。温度越稳定越好。
realWorldSecret.en: Milk should stay steadily chilled, ideally deeper inside the fridge instead of on the door. The more stable the temperature, the better.

realWorldSecret.cn: 奶酪放冷藏更稳，包好能避免失水和串味。封得太闷时，也可能容易出汗。
realWorldSecret.en: Cheese keeps best in the fridge and should be wrapped well to avoid drying out or picking up odors. If sealed too tightly, it may also sweat.

realWorldSecret.cn: 鸡胸肉如果不是马上要煮，尽快冷冻会更稳。先分装好，之后解冻会方便很多。
realWorldSecret.en: If you are not cooking chicken breast soon, freezing it early is the safest move. Portioning it first makes thawing much easier later.

realWorldSecret.cn: 牛肉想放久一点就适合冷冻。提前分成小份，不仅省空间，也更方便一次取用。
realWorldSecret.en: Beef is a great candidate for the freezer when you want to keep it longer. Dividing it into smaller portions saves space and makes cooking easier.

realWorldSecret.cn: 猪肉如果暂时不做，冷冻会更安心。分装保存还能减少反复解冻带来的浪费。
realWorldSecret.en: Pork keeps much better in the freezer if you are not using it soon. Freezing it in portions also helps avoid waste from repeated thawing.

realWorldSecret.cn: 三文鱼很娇气，买回家后尽量尽快冷藏并早点吃。拖太久的话，风味和口感都会掉得很快。
realWorldSecret.en: Salmon is delicate, so chill it as soon as possible and try to use it soon after buying. If left too long, both flavor and texture fade quickly.

realWorldSecret.cn: 虾的新鲜度掉得很快，不准备马上煮就尽快冷冻。越早处理，口感通常越好。
realWorldSecret.en: Shrimp loses freshness very quickly, so freeze it soon if you are not cooking it right away. The sooner it is stored properly, the better the texture usually stays.

realWorldSecret.cn: 花椰菜如果想保存更久，可以冷冻。先处理成小朵会更方便之后直接下锅。
realWorldSecret.en: Cauliflower can go into the freezer if you want to keep it longer. Cutting it into florets first makes it easier to cook later.

realWorldSecret.cn: 西芹想延长保存时间时，可以冷冻起来。切段后再冻，会更适合后面拿来煮汤或炒菜。
realWorldSecret.en: Celery can be frozen when you want to stretch its storage time. Cutting it into pieces first makes it easier to use later in soups or stir-fries.
